articles.title: Launch your WatsBuy store
articles.summary: A practical checklist to take your store from setup to launch.
content: Before you begin
Create your WatsBuy merchant account and confirm you can access the dashboard.
Prepare your business details, product catalogue, customer-support contact and payment-provider account where applicable.
Launch checklist
Complete your business profile and store settings.
Connect Meta and WhatsApp using the connection flow available in your WatsBuy dashboard.
Review message templates and messaging permissions where required.
Upload products, images, prices and inventory.
Connect a supported payment gateway if you accept online payments.
Place a test order and verify order updates and notifications.
Review your storefront on mobile and desktop before sharing it with customers.
Good to know
Menu names and available features depend on your live WatsBuy configuration and subscription.
Do not mark onboarding steps complete until the corresponding action has actually succeeded.

articles.title: Connect Meta Business to WatsBuy
articles.summary: Authorize the correct Meta business assets and confirm the connection status.
content: Prerequisites
A Meta account with access to the relevant business.
A Meta Business Portfolio and administrator permissions, where required.
Access to the business phone number and any verification method requested by Meta.
Legal business details and supporting documents, if requested.
Steps
Sign in to your WatsBuy merchant dashboard.
Open Settings → Integrations → Meta & WhatsApp (confirm the menu name in your live product).
Select Connect with Meta to start the supported Meta authorization or onboarding flow.
Sign in to Meta and select the correct business assets offered in the flow.
Review and authorize the permissions required for the WatsBuy integration.
Complete any verification, phone verification or review steps requested by Meta.
Return to WatsBuy and check the displayed connection status.
Run the connection test provided by WatsBuy, if available.
Possible statuses
Connected
Verification required
Action required
Connection failed
Important
Connecting an account does not automatically enable every feature. Verification, phone registration, template approval, permissions and billing may have separate requirements.
Use only the onboarding method implemented by WatsBuy. Do not assume every account uses the same Meta flow.

articles.title: Complete Meta Business Verification
articles.summary: Understand the information and steps that may be requested by Meta.
content: Before starting
Select the correct Meta Business Portfolio.
Have accurate legal business details and supporting documents available, if requested.
Make sure you have the permissions needed to manage the business.
Steps
Open the relevant business settings in Meta.
Locate the business verification area if it is available for your business.
Review the information requested by Meta.
Enter business details accurately and consistently with official records.
Submit the supporting documentation requested by Meta.
Complete any additional checks shown in the Meta interface.
Check the verification status and respond to any further requests.
If verification is delayed or rejected
Read the reason provided by Meta.
Check for mismatched business names, addresses or document details.
Submit corrected information through Meta's official process.
Contact WatsBuy support if your account connection or dashboard status appears inconsistent.
Important
Meta controls eligibility, approval decisions and review timelines. WatsBuy cannot guarantee approval by a fixed date.

articles.title: Understand Meta, WatsBuy and customer payment charges
articles.summary: Learn the difference between software subscriptions, WhatsApp messaging charges and customer checkout payments.
content: Three separate payment types
WatsBuy subscription: payment for access to WatsBuy software and the features included in your plan.
Meta WhatsApp charges: applicable messaging usage or related services. Billing may be handled directly by Meta or through a solution provider, depending on the arrangement.
Customer order payments: payments shoppers make for your products. These are processed by your configured payment gateway or supported payment method.
Why this matters
Paying a WatsBuy subscription does not necessarily cover Meta messaging charges or payment gateway fees.
Your Meta billing options depend on the account configuration and whether billing is direct or provider-managed.
Next steps
Check the billing arrangement for your WhatsApp Business Account.
If Meta directly bills your account and requires a payment method, follow the options displayed in Meta.
If a solution provider manages billing, follow that provider's instructions instead.
Review official pricing information before estimating message costs.
Important
Meta pricing, free allowances, billing options and policy rules can change. Do not rely on hardcoded rates in this guide; consult the current official Meta documentation.

articles.title: Set up or troubleshoot Meta billing
articles.summary: Find the right billing steps for your WhatsApp Business Platform account.
content: First identify your billing arrangement
Determine whether the account is billed directly by Meta, through a solution provider, or under another supported arrangement.
Not every merchant sees the same billing menu or payment options.
Steps
Sign in to Meta Business and select the relevant business.
Open the WhatsApp Business Account associated with your integration.
Locate the billing or payment settings available for that account.
If directly billed and a payment method is required, follow Meta's current instructions to add or update it.
Check for outstanding billing actions, failed payments or account restrictions.
Test messaging using the supported WatsBuy workflow and review any remaining errors.
Common issues
Payment method rejected: check the error and confirm the method is supported.
Messaging blocked by billing: review the relevant Meta or provider billing account.
Billing page unavailable: confirm your permissions and billing arrangement.
Unexpected charges: review usage, message categories, current rates and the billing statement.
Important
Do not share payment-card details, passwords or API secrets with support. WatsBuy should publish the exact billing instructions that match its actual integration.

articles.title: Connect a WhatsApp Business phone number
articles.summary: Understand the setup options for a new number or an existing WhatsApp Business number.
content: Choose the right path
New or eligible number: follow the supported Meta onboarding flow.
Existing number: confirm whether migration or a supported coexistence arrangement is available for your integration.
The available path depends on the number's current configuration and WatsBuy's implementation.
General setup
Start the Meta connection flow from WatsBuy.
Select or create the relevant WhatsApp Business Account if supported.
Enter the phone number and complete the verification method offered by Meta.
Complete registration and any account setup steps.
Return to WatsBuy and confirm the connection status.
Send a test message using the supported workflow.
Important
Do not delete an existing WhatsApp account or uninstall WhatsApp Business unless the official flow for your chosen setup specifically requires it.

articles.title: Create and submit a WhatsApp message template
articles.summary: Prepare a template and follow its review status before using it in a campaign.
content: Steps
Open the relevant WhatsApp Business Account in Meta or the template interface provided by your integration.
Create a template name and select the language.
Choose the appropriate message category.
Write the message body and add supported header, footer, buttons or variables as needed.
Review the content for accuracy and compliance with current Meta policies.
Submit the template for review.
Wait for the relevant approval status.
Sync or refresh template information in WatsBuy if supported.
Test the approved template before using it in a campaign.
Troubleshooting
If rejected, read Meta's reason and edit the template accordingly.
Check variable formatting and category selection.
Remember that approval and delivery are different events; an approved template is not guaranteed to reach every recipient.

articles.title: Connect a payment gateway to WatsBuy
articles.summary: Configure checkout and test the payment-to-order flow before accepting live payments.
content: Before you begin
Create an account with a payment provider supported by WatsBuy and complete its onboarding.
Confirm that the provider supports your country, business type and intended payment methods.
Have access to the provider dashboard and the required account permissions.
Steps
In WatsBuy, open Dashboard → Settings → Payments (confirm the menu name in your live product).
Select a gateway available for your merchant country and plan.
Connect using the method implemented by WatsBuy, such as an authorization flow or secure credential configuration.
Enable only payment methods supported by both the provider and WatsBuy.
Use test mode where available to test successful and failed payments.
Confirm order statuses and payment notifications update correctly.
Check that duplicate notifications do not create duplicate orders.
Activate live payments only after testing and provider approval.
Collection vs confirmation vs settlement
Collection: the customer submits payment for an order.
Confirmation: WatsBuy receives a transaction result from the provider.
Settlement: the provider transfers applicable funds to the merchant, subject to its schedule and deductions.
Security
Never share passwords, secret API keys or authentication tokens in support tickets, chat or email.

articles.title: Upload your first product
articles.summary: Add product information and verify how it appears in your storefront.
content: Steps
Open the catalogue or products area in your WatsBuy dashboard.
Add a product name, description, price and availability.
Upload clear product images and add variants if supported.
Assign a category and confirm inventory details.
Save the product and preview it in your store.
Check the product on a mobile screen and test the customer journey.
If a product is missing
Check whether it is saved, active and available for the current store.
Review required fields and image upload errors.
If catalogue sync is enabled, check the source platform and latest sync status.

articles.title: Configure the AI shopping assistant
articles.summary: Set up product knowledge and a helpful, accurate customer experience.
content: Preparation
Confirm that the AI shopping assistant is enabled for your WatsBuy account.
Make sure product names, descriptions, prices and availability are accurate.
Identify which AI capabilities are live in your account.
Setup checklist
Open the AI or assistant settings available in your dashboard.
Connect the supported product catalogue or knowledge source.
Configure the assistant's tone and allowed response behavior.
Define when a conversation should be transferred to a human agent, if supported.
Test product discovery, pricing questions and out-of-stock scenarios.
Review responses for inaccurate claims before enabling the assistant for customers.
Feature availability
Image-based discovery, voice shopping, automated order placement and advanced recommendations should be described as available only when implemented and enabled for the merchant.

articles.title: Prepare a WhatsApp campaign responsibly
articles.summary: Check audience eligibility, templates, consent and campaign results.
content: Before sending
Define the campaign objective and audience.
Confirm you have the required customer permissions and respect opt-out requests.
Use the appropriate approved template where required by Meta.
Review the message, offer details, links and destination page.
Send a test to an internal recipient where supported.
After sending
Review delivery and read metrics where available.
Monitor customer replies and opt-outs.
Use the actual campaign data to improve future messages.
Follow current Meta policies and applicable laws.

articles.title: Understand order statuses
articles.summary: Learn what each status means and which updates may be automatic.
content: Common statuses
Pending: awaiting the next required action or confirmation.
Processing: the order is being prepared.
Shipped: the order has been dispatched.
Delivered: delivery has been confirmed.
Cancelled: the order has been cancelled.
Returned: the order has been returned, where supported.
Keep records accurate
Check whether each status is updated manually or synchronized from a connected service.
Review payment confirmation separately from order status.
If a status appears incorrect, record the order reference and contact support without sharing sensitive payment credentials.

articles.title: Understand key commerce metrics
articles.summary: Use clear definitions to interpret your store and campaign performance.
content: Common metrics
Messages sent: messages submitted for sending.
Messages delivered: messages confirmed as delivered.
Read rate: delivered messages recorded as read, where available.
Product views: recorded product-view events.
Cart conversion: percentage of tracked carts that progress to completed orders.
Order conversion: percentage of a defined audience or session group that completes an order.
Average order value: qualifying order value divided by the number of qualifying orders.
Abandoned carts: carts meeting your configured abandonment definition.
Interpret results carefully
Check the metric's calculation, time window and data source.
Avoid comparing metrics that use different definitions or attribution windows.
Engagement alone does not prove that a campaign caused additional sales.

articles.title: Keep your WatsBuy account secure
articles.summary: Follow safe practices for account access, payment configuration and support requests.
content: Recommended practices
Use strong, unique credentials and enable available account protections.
Give team members only the permissions they need.
Remove access when a team member no longer needs it.
Use official provider dashboards for sensitive billing and account actions.
Never share passwords, secret API keys, one-time codes or full payment-card details in support tickets.
Review WatsBuy's published Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
Need help?
When submitting a ticket, provide the relevant error message, approximate time and non-sensitive account reference. Remove personal or payment details from screenshots where possible.

articles.title: What to include when reporting a technical issue
articles.summary: Help the support team investigate a problem without exposing sensitive information.
content: Include these details
The affected service: Meta, WhatsApp, payments, catalogue, AI, orders or analytics.
The error message and approximate time it occurred.
The steps you took before the issue appeared.
A relevant order or ticket reference, if applicable.
A screenshot with sensitive details removed.
Do not include
Passwords, one-time codes, secret API keys, authentication tokens or full payment-card details.
Before submitting
Check the relevant Help Center guide and try the documented steps. If the issue persists, open a support ticket and keep the ticket reference for follow-up.
